name: Comic Panels
description: The frame splits into slanted comic-book panels with gutters and ink borders; one after another in reading order, each panel lifts off the page with a zoom kick and a drop shadow and punches over to the second clip, then the gutters close up over the full second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: gutter
params.description: Width of the gutters between the panels, as a part of the frame height

params.name: gutter_color
params.description: Color of the gutters and of the page's margin

params.name: border_color
params.description: Color of the ink borders around the panels

params.name: seed
params.description: Changes the layout of the panels
